description: Go TUI (clasm) with scriptable command-line support for administering Caltech Library DLD's AWS EC2 instances, AMIs, launch templates, and key pairs, plus S3 buckets and backup archives, IAM roles/instance profiles/policies, and Invenio RDM's own SQL/OpenSearch backup and restore lifecycle, with cross-resource tag management and cloud-init inspection.
name: clasm
releaseNotes:
v0.0.12 fixes the restore defect behind caltechauthors issue #185 and adds a health check for RDM's log indices. A restore with include_global_state:false carries neither index templates nor data-stream definitions, so the app auto-created plain, text-mapped audit-log and job-logs indices and the admin audit-logs page silently stopped updating (HTTP 200, _shards.failed:1).

Three new forms under `clasm rdm-backup-and-restore <slug>` (RDM menu items 6, 7 and 8), each with -text|-json and -wait (default 5m, 0 checks once). `rdm-index-health` is a read-only check of the audit log and job logs: exit 0 healthy, 1 a problem (missing template, plain or orphaned log index, text mappings, failed shards, a plain index that a data-stream template claims). `install-index-templates` installs the templates the app would install, only the missing ones, through the app's own routine; it never overwrites, and a run with nothing missing exits 0 (DR-0199). `convert-log-indices` turns orphaned and plain log indices back into real data streams, copying first; it needs `--confirm` on a production instance (DR-0180). Copies are named `clasm-fix-*` and clasm never deletes them.

Restore OpenSearch (menu and command line) now ends with the install, the conversion and the health check, after the verified restore and the snapshot cleanup, with no second confirmation (DR-0199). The check's verdict is the restore's: a restore whose health check fails exits 1. Log indices are found by what they are, not by the alias, which a live restore of a pre-repair snapshot showed to matter. Verified live on a test instance.

Snapshots taken from a real data stream restore as a real data stream; older snapshots hold the orphan form, so the conversion stays.
